This appears to be the WLAN module for a ''[[Sanyo]]'' projector.
"1AA4B10C5950B_X1", "A_SIDE" (non-component side) + "B_SIDE" (component side), :and a boxed ''G'' with "A30C5" underneath it (non-component side) :is silkscreened on the module breakout board in the FCC photos.
A MAC address with a 00:13:E0 (''[[Murata]]'') OUI (particularly, 00:13:E0:53:5F:CA) :is laser engraved to the top of the module's shield.
The device is presumed to be fully ''[[Marvell]]'' based as it is using the 88W8015 RF chip.
